title: Made with Love and Some Other Sh*t Fried Egg Heart Oven Mitt
writeup: The Made with Love and Some Other Sh*t oven mitt, the one with the fried-egg heart, is $4.99 new at Woot. Crazy Dog T-Shirts, the brand's own store, sells the exact same mitt (model 021LoveAndOtherShitMAMIT, UPC 192704754119) for $9.99, so this is half off. It is machine washable and about 9 by 8 inches. Only 3 were left when we checked, limit 3 per order.
